explanation: The RTL correctly implements a synchronous, non-bypassing, lossless ready/valid queue with capacity 2**ADDR_WIDTH. Reset is active-high synchronous, flushing pointers and count while forcing s_ready and m_valid low. Handshake uses valid/ready on rising edges. m_valid reflects buffered words exactly, head data stable while stalled. s_ready asserted when capacity available or head word consumed (full simultaneous enqueue/dequeue supported). Ordering preserved via circular buffer; new traffic works after reset. No syntax or behavioral faults detected; the code adheres to Verilog 2001 and meets all contract requirements.
